title: Online Meetings
completion_message: ¡Perfecto! Ya estás preparado para manejar cualquier situación en una reunión virtual en inglés.

parts.visual: Problemas de audio/video: You are on mute (Estás en silencio). The connection is bad (La conexión es mala). Your screen is frozen (Tu pantalla está congelada). Background noise (Ruido de fondo).
parts.audio: Audio and video issues. You are on mute. The connection is bad. Your screen is frozen. Background noise.

parts.visual: Acciones comunes: Share my screen (Compartir mi pantalla). Turn on/off the camera (Encender/apagar la cámara). Join the meeting (Unirse a la reunión). Send the link (Enviar el enlace).
parts.audio: Common actions. Share my screen. Turn on or off the camera. Join the meeting. Send the link.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra o frase correcta para reuniones virtuales.

questions.question: I can't hear you. I think you are on ____. (En silencio/muteado).
questions.explanation: You are on mute = tienes el micrófono silenciado.

questions.question: Let me ____ my screen with you. (Compartir).
questions.explanation: Share my screen = compartir mi pantalla.

questions.question: Please turn ____ your camera. I want to see you. (Encender).
There is a lot of background ____. Please mute your mic. (Ruido).
I think your screen is ____. You are not moving. (Congelada).
questions.explanation: Frozen = congelado (cuando el video se pausa por mala conexión).

questions.question: The ____ is very bad today. I can't hear you well. (Conexión).
questions.explanation: The connection = la conexión a internet.

questions.question: Can you send me the ____ to the meeting? (Enlace/Link).
questions.explanation: Send the link = enviar el enlace (URL).

questions.question: I can't ____ the meeting. It asks for a password. (Unirme a).
questions.explanation: Join a meeting = unirse a una reunión.

questions.question: Could you ____ that, please? I lost my connection for a second. (Repetir).
I will put the document in the ____ box. (Caja de chat).
questions.explanation: Chat box = la ventana/caja del chat de la videollamada.

questions.question: You are breaking ____. I can only hear parts of your sentence. (Te estás cortando).
questions.explanation: Breaking up = cortarse (el audio de la llamada).

questions.question: Wait a minute, I need to ____ my headphones. (Conectar/Enchufar).
Can everyone ____ my screen? (Ver).
questions.explanation: Can you see my screen? = ¿pueden ver mi pantalla?

questions.question: I'm going to ____ the meeting now so we can review it later. (Grabar).
Who is the ____ of this meeting? They need to let me in. (Anfitrión).
questions.explanation: Host = anfitrión (quien creó la reunión en Zoom/Teams).

questions.question: Please ____ your hand if you have a question. (Levantar).
questions.explanation: Raise your hand = levantar la mano (física o virtualmente).

questions.question: I have to jump to another ____ now. Bye! (Llamada/Reunión).
questions.explanation: Jump to another call = saltar a otra llamada (reunión).

questions.question: We are waiting for John to ____. (Conectarse/Entrar).
I got ____ off the meeting. Let me join again. (Desconectado/Echado).
questions.explanation: I got kicked off = me desconectó (el sistema me echó).
